notes.title: Unusually usual update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36348625/31a9d366118d800a6e0b292ae47b41a3e83c23a4.png[/img]

I’ve decided to update my debut project just to stay turned. I’ve got rid of excess visual noise and have tried to make the visuals closer to the original idea. Also, I’ve changed all the art and supplemented a few slides.

Thanks for playing, reading and listening!
